entries.what: Rafael has brakes lab at Tamsen Valley College from 8 to 11, then helps Gladys pick up masa supplies at Ruiz Family Market, where Chuy gives the family price on pork shoulder.
entries.outcome: Supplies stocked for the weekend stand.

entries.what: Evening pickup soccer at Delgado Park, then he watches engine teardown videos in bed on his cracked phone at 20% battery.
Engine performance with Salas from 1 to 4; Dante pitches his Tuesday salvage auction picks again during the lab break.
entries.outcome: Rafael says he will think about it.

entries.what: Fills the Tacoma at the Ruel Road station for about $50 and drives home along Pell Road, then studies G1 chapter headings for the first practice quiz.
entries.outcome: Planned to take the quiz Wednesday.

entries.what: Brakes lab in the morning, then takes the first G1 practice quiz on his laptop at the school library and scores 58%. He blanked and changed three right answers to wrong ones.
entries.outcome: Score 58%; well below the 70% he needs.

entries.what: Late morning he texts the assistant a refrigerant handling question from the quiz, saying he knows it on the car but not in the words.
Eats a quiet dinner at home with Oscar and Gladys, who ask how class went. He says fine and does not mention the score.
Asks the assistant for help wording a request to reschedule a brakes-lab makeup so it will not collide with his Thursday stand shift.
entries.outcome: Drafted a short message to the instructor.

entries.what: Engine performance with Salas from 1 to 4, then helps Oscar load the canopy and generator for the Thursday stand.
Runs the griddle through the evening stand shift and teardown, home late.
entries.outcome: Good sales; Gladys logs them in the green notebook.

entries.what: Skips nothing in the morning but sleeps badly; he reviews flashcard notes between classes and has lunch at the college.
Works the Friday stand evening, then at 9 p.m. picks up Dulce from Taquería Colima and drives her home to Marisol Gardens.
Sees the Ridgeline hiring fair line on Ruel Road while driving to the stand and honks at a friend in it, but does not stop.
entries.outcome: Kept going to the market prep.

entries.what: Saturday stand shift with Ximena helping; she asks if he has thought about the shop dream.
entries.outcome: He shrugs it off and changes the subject.

entries.what: Teardown at night and bed past midnight.
Sunday market stand at Delgado Park from 8 to 2, with Luz selling elotes nearby.
Afternoon nap, then a family dinner at home.
Plans to retry the G1 material and looks up flashcard ideas before bed.
